exclusions.reason: Large apparent NO signal is held back: returning-player recovery, changed lineup and prior-season calibration need review.
The current simulator stops after the regular season; it does not estimate playoff/title probabilities.

methodology: All 30 teams over 200 seeded seasons. Both sides of every collected win threshold screened. Two team thresholds selected editorially for follow-up, not mechanically optimal picks. Five-win stress is a hypothetical shift, not an injury forecast. Two-cent reserve is a cost stress, not verified exchange fees. No held-out betting evaluation; inspecting many contracts creates selection bias.
limitations: Scenario hit rates are not calibrated real-world probabilities. Monte Carlo intervals quantify simulation sampling only, not model error.
All players available, fixed rotations, no future trades, 30 provisional schedule games. Bench minutes require review.
No verified depth, executable fills or current series-specific fees; no trade-ready edge or stake sizing.
MVP historical statistics verified against saved parquet; descriptive value does not imply award odds.
